/**
 * The audio brief's script (plan F37): the Writer drafts two hosts' lines from the folder's most
 * central passages; every quote is checked in code and in Zetaris, and the Verifier keeps a line
 * only if its passage supports it (a line with no citation only if it states no fact). What's
 * left is what gets spoken, so nothing unsupported is ever said aloud.
 */
export async function writeBrief(windows: StudyWindow[], name: string, tracer?: Tracer) {
  const passages = windows.flatMap((w) => w.passages)
  const labelled = passages.map((p, i) => ({ label: `p${i + 1}`, p }))
  const byLabel = new Map(labelled.map((l) => [l.label, l.p]))
  const started = performance.now()
  const { result, choice } = await withFallback("writer", "writer", tracer, "brief", (c) =>
    generateText({
      model: model(c),
      providerOptions: reasoning(c),
      output: Output.object({ schema: Script }),
      instructions: BRIEF_INSTRUCTIONS,
      prompt: `Material: "${name}"\n\n${labelled
        .map(({ label, p }) => `[${label}] (${p.title}) ${p.text.replace(/\p{Cc}/gu, " ")}`)
        .join("\n")}`,
    }),
  )
  tracer?.log({
    agent: "writer",
    step: "brief",
    action: "wrote_script",
    model: choice.id,
    latencyMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
    tokens: { input: result.usage.inputTokens, output: result.usage.outputTokens },
    rowsReturned: result.output.lines.length,
  })

  // Code check: a cited line's quote must be in the passage it names (or, misnamed, in another).
  let dropped = 0
  const drafted = result.output.lines.flatMap((line) => {
    const text = line.text.trim()
    if (!text) return []
    if (!line.passage || !line.quote) return [{ line, text, at: null as StudyPassage | null }]
    const key = quoteKey(line.quote)
    const named = byLabel.get(line.passage.trim())
    const at =
      key.length < 12
        ? undefined
        : named && quoteKey(named.text).includes(key)
          ? named
          : passages.find((p) => quoteKey(p.text).includes(key))
    if (!at) {
      dropped++
      return []
    }
    return [{ line, text, at }]
  })

  // Zetaris confirms every quote in its own reading of the source, in one statement.
  const cited = drafted.flatMap((d, i) => (d.at ? [{ i, d }] : []))
  const zetaris = await checkQuotes(
    cited.map(({ i, d }) => ({
      qid: `b${i}`,
      fileId: (d.at as StudyPassage).fileId,
      passageId: (d.at as StudyPassage).id,

/**
 * A two-voice script → one mp3 (ElevenLabs Text-to-Dialogue, plan F37). The response's own line
 * timings drift up to 1.8 s after 30 s (S00), so they're kept only as a fallback: the brief's
 * times come from a Scribe pass over this audio (`timeLines`).
 */
export async function speakDialogue(lines: SpokenLine[]) {
  client ??= new ElevenLabsClient({ apiKey: env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY })
  const res = (await client.textToDialogue.convertWithTimestamps({
    modelId: BRIEF.model,
    outputFormat: BRIEF.outputFormat,
    inputs: lines.map((l) => ({ text: l.text, voiceId: l.voiceId })),
  } as never)) as {
    audioBase64: string
    voiceSegments?: {
      startTimeSeconds: number
      endTimeSeconds: number
      dialogueInputIndex: number
    }[]
  }
  const segments = res.voiceSegments ?? []
  return {
    audio: new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(res.audioBase64, "base64")),
    /** Each line's span by the dialogue API's own clock (drifts; a fallback only). */
    approximate: lines.map((_, i) => {
      const mine = segments.filter((s) => s.dialogueInputIndex === i)
      return {
        start: mine[0]?.startTimeSeconds ?? 0,
        end: mine.at(-1)?.endTimeSeconds ?? mine[0]?.startTimeSeconds ?? 0,
      }
    }),
  }
}

/**
 * Each script line's start and end in the real audio: the script's words are walked in order
 * against Scribe's timed words, each matched to the next equal word within a short look-ahead
 * (Scribe may split or drop one). A line no word of which matched keeps its fallback time.
 */
export function timeLines(
  texts: string[],
  words: Word[],
  fallback: { start: number; end: number }[],
): { start: number; end: number }[] {
  const heard = words.flatMap((w) =>
    wordsOf(w.text).map((t) => ({ t, start: w.start, end: w.end })),
  )
  let at = 0
  return texts.map((text, i) => {
    let start: number | undefined
    let end: number | undefined
    for (const word of wordsOf(text)) {
      for (let k = at; k < Math.min(heard.length, at + 6); k++) {
        if (heard[k]?.t === word) {
          start ??= heard[k]?.start
          end = heard[k]?.end
          at = k + 1
          break
        }
      }
    }
    const fb = fallback[i] ?? { start: 0, end: 0 }
    return start != null && end != null ? { start, end } : fb
  })
}

/** Recording → words with timestamps and speakers (ElevenLabs Scribe v2; 0% word errors in S00). */
export async function transcribe(
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  filename: string,
): Promise<{ words: Word[]; duration: number }> {
  client ??= new ElevenLabsClient({ apiKey: env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY })
  const result = (await client.speechToText.convert({
    file: new File([Buffer.from(bytes)], filename),
    modelId: INGEST.transcriptionModel,
    timestampsGranularity: "word",
    diarize: true,
    tagAudioEvents: false,
  })) as {
    words?: { text: string; start?: number; end?: number; type?: string; speakerId?: string }[]
  }
  const words = (result.words ?? [])
    .filter((w) => w.type !== "spacing" && w.text.trim())
    .map((w) => ({
      text: w.text.trim(),
      start: w.start ?? 0,
      end: w.end ?? w.start ?? 0,
      speaker: w.speakerId,
    }))
  return { words, duration: words.at(-1)?.end ?? 0 }
}

/**
 * Text read aloud with word timings (plan §16.5 "Read aloud"): ElevenLabs Flash with timestamps,
 * cached in storage by hash(voice + model + text), so a clip is made once for everyone and a
 * cached one costs nothing. Only newly made characters count against the daily cap.
 */
export async function speak(
  ownerId: string,
  text: string,
  who: "speaker" | "asker",
  /** Konkyo's lines are said in the voice the person chose (the sounds popover). */
  voiceId?: string,
): Promise<Clip> {
  const voice = who === "speaker" && voiceId ? { id: voiceId } : VOICE[who]
  const said = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, VOICE.maxSpeakChars)
  if (!said) throw new LibraryError("Nothing to read", 400)
  const hash = createHash("sha256")
    .update(`${voice.id}|${VOICE.ttsModel}|${VOICE.outputFormat}|${said}`)
    .digest("hex")
    .slice(0, 40)
  const timing = objectKey("audio", "tts", `${hash}.json`)
  if (await headObject(timing).catch(() => null)) {
    const words = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await getBytes(timing))) as SpokenWord[]
    return { hash, words }
  }
  const refund = await charge(ownerId, "speak", said.length, "readAloud")
  const res = await fetch(
    `${API}/text-to-speech/${voice.id}/with-timestamps?output_format=${VOICE.outputFormat}`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "xi-api-key": env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ text: said, model_id: VOICE.ttsModel }),
    },
  )
  if (!res.ok) {
    await refund()
    console.error("[voice] speak", res.status, (await res.text()).slice(0, 200))
    throw new LibraryError("Couldn't read that aloud right now.", 503)
  }
  const body = (await res.json()) as {
    audio_base64: string
    alignment: Parameters<typeof wordsOf>[0]
  }
  const words = wordsOf(body.alignment)
  await putBytes(
    objectKey("audio", "tts", `${hash}.mp3`),
    Buffer.from(body.audio_base64, "base64"),
    "audio/mpeg",
  )
  await putBytes(timing, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(words)), "application/json")
  return { hash, words }
}

/**
 * Answer out loud in a study round (plan S16, "spoken answers in study rounds"): a small orb beside
 * the answer field. Tap it and talk: the words fill the field as Scribe hears them, and the pause
 * checks the answer, the same as pressing check. No mic: it says so and the field stays.
 */
export function SayIt({
  onWords,
  onDone,
  disabled,
  keyterms,
}: {
  onWords: (text: string) => void
  onDone: () => void
  disabled?: boolean
  /** The round's own words, so Scribe hears its terms right. */
  keyterms?: string[]
}) {
  const done = useRef(onDone)
  done.current = onDone
  const voice = useVoice(
    {
      words: (text) => onWords(text.replace(/[.!?]+$/, "")),
      ask: (said) => {
        onWords(said.replace(/[.!?]+$/, ""))
        // the field has the words on the next render; check then, with the newest handler
        window.setTimeout(() => done.current(), 60)
        return undefined
      },
    },
    { keyterms },
  )
  const listening = voice.state === "listening"
  useEffect(() => {
    if (disabled && listening) voice.cancel()
  }, [disabled, listening, voice])

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={`say-it${listening ? " is-listening" : ""}`}
      disabled={disabled}
      onPointerDown={() => !listening && primeVoice()}
      onClick={() => {
        if (listening) {
          sound("tap")
          voice.finish("done")
          return
        }
        sound("promote")
        void voice.start()
      }}
      aria-pressed={listening}
      title={voice.problem ?? (listening ? "done" : "say it")}
    >
      <span className="say-it-orb" aria-hidden="true">
        <VoiceOrb state={listening ? "listening" : "idle"} level={voice.level} />
      </span>
      <b>{voice.problem ? "type it" : listening ? "listening…" : "say it"}</b>
    </button>

/** A single-use Scribe realtime token (15 minutes), counted as one voice session. */
export async function scribeToken(ownerId: string): Promise<string> {
  const refund = await charge(ownerId, "listen", 1, "voiceSessions")
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/single-use-token/realtime_scribe`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "xi-api-key": env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY },
  })
  const body = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { token?: string }
  if (!res.ok || !body.token) {
    await refund()
    console.error("[voice] token", res.status)
    throw new LibraryError("Voice isn't available right now. Type instead.", 503)
  }
  return body.token
}

/**
 * Groups timed words into passages: a new passage starts at a speaker change, after a pause, or
 * once the current one passes the target length and reaches a sentence end. Each citation can then
 * seek the recording to the passage's first word.
 */
export function wordsToPassages(words: Word[]): TranscriptPassage[] {
  const out: TranscriptPassage[] = []
  let current: Word[] = []
  const flush = () => {
    const first = current[0]
    const last = current.at(-1)
    if (first && last) {
      out.push({
        text: current
          .map((w) => w.text)
          .join(" ")
          .replace(/\s+([,.;:!?])/g, "$1"),
        tStart: first.start,
        tEnd: last.end,
        speaker: first.speaker ?? null,
      })
    }
    current = []
  }
  for (const word of words) {
    const last = current.at(-1)
    if (last) {
      const speakerChange = word.speaker !== last.speaker
      const pause = word.start - last.end > INGEST.transcriptPauseSeconds
      const long = last.end - (current[0]?.start ?? last.end) > INGEST.transcriptPassageSeconds
      if (speakerChange || pause || (long && /[.!?]$/.test(last.text))) flush()
    }
    current.push(word)
  }
  flush()
  return out
}
